subject.title: fix(telegram): preserve word boundaries in proactive sends

question: Should this PR wait for an exact-head live Telegram proof, or should a maintainer explicitly override the repository's Telegram transport-proof requirement?
rationale: The implementation and focused tests are convincing, but the required user-visible transport evidence cannot be supplied by the contributor's current environment and the attempted Mantis run never reached Telegram.

options.title: Run exact-head Telegram proof
options.body: Authorize a candidate-only Mantis run that sends long proactive Markdown and records whole-word boundaries plus the readable HTML-rejection fallback.

options.title: Explicitly override proof
options.body: A maintainer may accept the focused test evidence without a live run, owning the remaining message-delivery uncertainty.

recommendation.title: Run exact-head Telegram proof
recommendation.body: Authorize a candidate-only Mantis run that sends long proactive Markdown and records whole-word boundaries plus the readable HTML-rejection fallback.

likelyOwner.reason: Their merged history covers both the cron formatting path and Telegram outbound chunking behavior involved in this decision.
